project_type: Jarvis personal AI agent: Python backend (stdlib http.server panel at app/ui/panel/server.py, started with `python -m app.main`) + React 19/Vite 7/TypeScript frontend in frontend/ (served from frontend/dist).
build_system: Python: pyproject.toml (setuptools), dependencies installed with `python -m pip install ...`. Frontend: npm; `npm run build` = `tsc -b && vite build` writing only frontend/dist. NEVER run `npm run build:mobile`; mobile_app/ must not change.
test_framework: pytest (tests/, conftest.py isolates action journal and tasks); browser smoke scripts frontend/tests/*.smoke.cjs (plain node + Playwright with mocked /api/**).
build_command: cd frontend; node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json; npm run build
test_command: python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short tests/test_fsrs.py tests/test_language_store.py tests/test_tutor_store.py tests/test_panel_tutor_api.py tests/test_review_undo.py tests/test_study_xp.py tests/test_study_api.py tests/test_language_mode.py tests/test_turn_tool_allowlist.py tests/test_tool_catalog.py tests/test_action_kernel.py tests/test_tools_smoke.py tests/test_orchestrator_enem.py tests/test_situational_context.py
verification_instructions: 1) Run the pytest list above (only files that exist at that point). 2) In frontend/: tsc --noEmit and npm run build. 3) UI: start `npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174` in background (run_in_background), then in frontend/: `$env:PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE='C:\Users\maria\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python311\Lib\site-packages\playwright\driver\package'; $env:PANEL_TEST_URL='http://127.0.0.1:5174'; $env:PANEL_TEST_OUTPUT='c:\Users\maria\Desktop\Jarvis\.agents\tasks\estudos-fases-1-2\screenshots'; node tests/study.smoke.cjs`; stop the Vite process afterwards. 4) `git status --short mobile_app` must be empty. 5) After code changes: `graphify update .` from repo root (final step).
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/dist (npm run build) and graphify-out/ (`graphify update .`, final step) are NOT tracked by git - nothing generated gets committed. data/ is gitignored and must never be written by tests.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Work directly on branch main in c:\Users\maria\Desktop\Jarvis (no worktree), small local commits, never push. .agents/tasks/ IS tracked by git: stage files by name, never stage .agents/tasks/estudos-fases-1-2/**. Never read/write c:\Users\maria\Desktop\Jarvis\data in tests (use tmp_path). Do NOT modify app/services/memory_*, habits or lifestyle tools (a parallel investigation owns them). Write files with the edit/write tools in UTF-8 (PowerShell Set-Content causes mojibake; frontend/tests/broken-text.cjs checks for it). Python: C:\Users\maria\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python311\python.exe (`python`). `fsrs` is NOT installed yet: FEAT-002 installs it with `python -m pip install "fsrs>=6.3,<7"` (6.3.2, MIT, Python>=3.10, deps: typing-extensions). Playwright Python 1.61 with Node driver package at the path above (page.clock available). Repo rule .agents/rules/Regra.md: user-facing chat replies start with the name 'Jean'.
contribution_requirements: All UI text in Brazilian Portuguese. Follow existing style; minimal, clean code; no unrelated refactors. Every agent tool must have Action Kernel metadata (TOOL_CATALOG in app/agent/tools/catalog.py); the chat executor only accepts tools allowed for the current mode and turn (registry.allowed_tool_names == get_tool_declarations names) - keep that invariant. Confirmations use the app's custom dialog (frontend/src/components/ConfirmDialog.tsx), never window.confirm. No new heavy frontend deps (no chart lib in package.json -> plain SVG/CSS). Final report in Portuguese at docs/estudos-fases-1-2-2026-11-11.md.
key_patterns: Backend stores are JSON-file classes with storage_dir param (TutorStore data/tutor/progress.json, LanguageStore data/language/progress.json) and _load/_save; tests construct them with tmp_path. Panel API modules expose handle_X_get(parts, handler) / handle_X_post(path, body, handler) returning (status, dict) or None, resolving stores via handler.orchestrator (see app/ui/panel/api/language.py `_store`); server.py iterates them in two tuples (GET ~line 746, POST ~line 2108). Delete convention: POST /api/.../{id}/delete (app/ui/panel/api/checklists.py). Tools: BaseTool subclasses in app/agent/tools/*.py; ToolMetadata entries like the whiteboard_* ones in catalog.py (~line 620). Orchestrator mode branch at app/agent/orchestrator.py:458 (`if mode == "tutor"`), registry mode filtering in app/agent/tools/registry.py allowed_tool_names (~line 374). Orchestrator prompt tests build AgentOrchestrator via __new__ with a CapturingLLM recording system_instruction (tests/test_situational_context.py ~line 140-200). HTTP API tests start PanelHandler on HTTPServer port 0 (tests/test_panel_tutor_api.py). Frontend: hooks in frontend/src/hooks (useStudy, useLanguage) are created in App.tsx and passed as props to StudyPage; LanguagePage is rendered inside StudyPage (mode 'language') via languageProps spread; StudyToolbar modes: plan('Hoje'), learn, questions, review, feynman, quiz, progress, language. Overlay panels use .study-overlay-panel (styles.css ~1866). main.tsx uses React StrictMode (updater functions run twice in dev).
directory_structure: app/agent (orchestrator, modes/, tools/), app/storage (JSON stores; tutor/ holds the scheduler), app/ui/panel (server.py + api/ route modules), app/services (do not touch memory_*/habits), tests/ (pytest), frontend/src (App.tsx, pages/, hooks/, components/study/, utils/, styles.css, types.ts, navigation.ts), frontend/tests (*.smoke.cjs Playwright scripts), docs/ (reports), graphify-out/ (knowledge graph; `graphify query "..."`).
